title: Alex Cross
desc: While investigating a murder, Alex Cross learns of a ruthless serial killer. However, things soon spiral out of control, leading him on a quest for revenge and uncovering a dark web of conspiracy.

title: Sherlock Holmes
desc: Arthur Doyle's legendary detective joined by his loyal partner Dr. Watson tries to stop an occult-dabbling criminal who has returned from the dead.

title: The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part
desc: It's been five years since everything was awesome and the citizens are facing a huge new threat: Lego Duplo invaders from outer space, wrecking everything faster than they can rebuild.

title: Mission: Impossible II
desc: IMF agent Ethan Hunt is sent to Sydney to find and destroy a genetically modified disease called 'Chimera'.

title: Shrek
desc: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre, who must go on a quest and rescue a princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

title: Bumblebee
desc: In 1987, on the run, Bumblebee hides in a California junkyard, where Charlie discovers and revives him, realizing he is no ordinary yellow Volkswagen but a battle-scarred Autobot.

title: Justice League
desc: Iconic superheroes unite to fight evil forces threatening Earth, showcasing courage, teamwork, and sacrifice in an epic battle between light and darkness.

title: Transformers
desc: An ancient struggle between two Cybertronian races, the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons, comes to Earth, with a clue to the ultimate power held by a teenager.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man
desc: After Peter Parker is bitten by a genetically altered spider, he gains newfound, spider-like powers and ventures out to save the city from the machinations of a mysterious reptilian foe.

title: Rambo: First Blood
desc: Green Beret veteran Rambo takes on a Pacific Northwest sheriff and the National Guard.

title: Impractical Jokers: The Movie
desc: Four lifelong friends receive three Paula Abdul concert tickets. They compete with hilarious pranks, each determined to win a chance to attend the show.
